paite: Huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, Jerusalem ah apa sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoahaz / (2 Kum 23.30-35)

paite: Jehoahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum vai ahawm hi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n Jerusalem a avaihawmna atawpsak a, agam uh dangkasik talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat aliausak hi.
Aigupta kumpipa'n a-unaupa Eliakim, Judah leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akhensak hi. Huchi in Neko in a-unaupa Jehoahaz Aigupta gam ah api hi.
Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi. TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim / (2 Kum 23.36-24.7)

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar amah sual ding in ahong kuan a, Babulon a pi ding in kol abunsak hi.
Nebukadnezzar in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan leng Babulon ah apua a, Babulon a atempul ah akoih hi.
Jehoiakim tanchin dangte, athilkihhuai hihte leh a-omdante, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpite tanchinbu ah atuang hi. Huan asik in atapa Jehoiakin in vai ahawmta hi.
Jehoiakin in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum leh ni sawm vai ahawm a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakin / (2 Kum 24.8-17)

paite: Kum abei in kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in mi asawl a, TOUPA in atui-um belsuan hoih pipite toh Babulon ah apisak a, a-unaupa Zedekiah, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl hi.
Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah / (2 Kum 24.18-20; Jer 52.1-3)

paite: TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; TOUPA kam a kipan a thugenpa zawlnei Jeremiah lak ah akiniamkhiak nuam kei hi.
Pathian min a kichiamsakpa kumpipa Nebukadnezzar tung ah ahel lai a, genhaktak in a-om a, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian lam nga lou ding in alungsim akhauhsak hi.
heading: Jerusalem Puksiatna / (2 Kum 25.1-21; Jer 52.3b-11)

paite: Siampu heutu tengteng leh mipite'n leng Pathian thei lou mite mah bang in thilkihhuai pipite ahih ua, Jerusalem a hihsiangthou TOUPA' innte leng ahihbuah uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N amite leh a-omna mun alainat ziak in apipute uh Pathian in akiang uah theihtawp a phatuamngai in mi asawl hi.
Himahleh Pathian misawlte amusit ua, athute angaineu ua, amite tung ah TOUPA hehna ahong thou a, hih lungdam nawnna mahmah om lou khop in azawlneite ahihgim uhi.
Huaiziak in atung uah Kaldai kumpipa agamtangsak a, ama'n atangvalte uh amun siangthou uah namsau in athat a, nungak leh tangval, tek, teksia kuamah lainatna anei kei a; akhut ah ape vek hi.
Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng, aneu leh alian, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawm tengteng, kumpipa sum koihkhawm leh amiliante sum koihkhawmte nangawn in Babulon ah apo vek hi.
Pathian innte ahal a, Jerusalem kulhte achimsak a, huai lai a inn thupi tengteng ahal a, huai lai a tui-um belsuan hoih tengteng ahihse vek hi.
Namsau thah bang teng Babulon ah api a, Persiate ahong laltak un, sikha in amah leh atapate a-om uhi.
Gam in nuamtak a a Sabbathte azattan a Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen atangtunna ding in, segawp a a-om sung teng, kum sawmsagih tangtunna ding in, a Sabbathte atang uhi.

Huchi in Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm tung kum in Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu atunkim theihna ding in agam tengteng a thankhiak vek ding leh agelh a gelh ding in leng TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura lungtang atokthou hi.
heading: Kura In Judate Kik Nawn Ding Thu Apia / (Ezr 1.1-4)

paite: Persia kumpipa Kura in hichi in achi: "Khovel gam tengteng TOUPA, van Pathian in ahon pia a; Judah gam a Jerusalem ah a-inn lamsak ding in thu ahon pia ahi. Na lak ua ama mite photphot kiang ah TOUPA a Pathian om henla, va hohtou uhen," chi in.
